verses: The white elms by the east gate grow, And clumps of oaks crown Yuan Ch'iu's head; There Tzu-chung's daughter oft we see, Dancing about beneath their shade.
On a bright morning they have fixed, To seek the plain that southward lies. Then from her task of twisting hemp, See! dancing through the mart she hies.
The morning fair, young men and girls Together go. You hear a youth Say to his mate, "O sunflower bright, Pledge me with pepper stalk your truth!"
